Great Tips For Conquering Pet Stain And Odors

December 04, 2020

For you pet lovers out there, we cannot deny the fact that they are already part of our family. Your furry and cute pets bring joy and happiness to your lives, with a minor gripe from their urine, hairs, and feces.

These pet accidents highly make your cleaning chores more challenging and time-consuming, since they cannot be easily removed all the time. With that, we are sharing the best tricks for your pet stain and odor removerneeds.

Nevertheless, if you want to stay away from these stressful cleaning dilemmas, then you can quickly call us over for your professional cleaning service. Without further delays, let’s dive in.

#1 Daily Washing of Your Pet’s Beddings

Your pet’s beddings provide comfort and protection for your furry friend’s body and the area where it’s located. However, it also becomes a house for pet hairs, urine, and feces, which can produce a nasty smell around your home.

With that, you have to schedule a regular cleaning pattern for the beddings, and you can use either commercial or home-made pet stain eraser. Also, always read the washing instructions for your pet beddings, and adjust your washing machine setting to match its size.

Moreover, you can apply the bedding with a protective coating to enhance its resistance against moisture, stains, and pet accidents.

#2 Remove Pet Danders Through Regular Vacuuming

It is a fact that your pets will shed hairs oftentimes, so it will be all over the beddings and carpets inside your home. To counter that burden, you need to daily vacuum your carpets, upholstery, pet beddings, and other areas where your pets usually roam around.

Moreover, this is a must when you have an asthmatic family member, so be sure to use strong HEPA wet/dry vacuums for this task.

#3 Periodically Bathe Your Pets

Have you tried not bathing your pet for a week or two? Their pungent odor is strong right? Your pet’s nasty body odor will contribute to a stinky smell inside your home, so you need to take note of their bathing schedule.

In line, be meticulous in finding the appropriate pet shampoo that will safely and efficiently remove the smell and lice from your pet’s hair. Nevertheless, we offer affordable pet odor eliminatoradd-on service for our residential and commercial cleaning package.

#4 Install An Air Purifier Unit

Meanwhile, installing or buying an air purifier unit will be your prerogative, depending on how it’s necessary inside your home or office. These innovative machines are equipped with activated carbon, air filters, and deodorizing compounds which effectively cleans your indoor air.

Your upfront cost will be higher in the first stage only, yet it can efficiently help you reduce the air pollutants and pet odor removal cost. Consequently, you need to observe proper care and maintenance on your air purifier to keep its functional life longer.

#5 Regularly Clean Your Pet’s Toys and Leashes

Besides your pet’s beddings, their toys and leashes must be well-maintained all the time; because their saliva will be all over it, which can produce a distinct smell. There are even instances when your pets will pee or delicate on their toys, so you need to secure a pet pee stain remover.

Meanwhile, availing professional cleaning assistance is also another alternative to completely tackle all those areas affected by pet accidents and stains. At Shiny Carpet Cleaning, we offer very reasonable rates for our pet stain and odor removal services. Simply give us a call, and we’ll find a way to book you early.

#6 Baking Soda – DIY Deodorizer

If you are looking for a homemade odor neutralizer compound, then your food-grade baking soda is a great option. All you have to do is sprinkle a substantial amount of it to the affected area (like beddings or carpets), then let it sit for a few minutes (15 to 20 minutes). After, you can vacuum that area applied with baking soda.

#7 Carpet Steam Cleaning

Availing carpet steam cleaning service is offered by many local cleaning companies like Shiny Carpet Cleaning. It’s a very effective method since we use pressurized hot water to deeply clean your beddings, rugs, carpets, and upholstery affected by pet accidents. In line, we also use a counter-rotating brush to facilitate stirring on those fabrics for an enhanced stain removal action.

Moreover, to enhance stain and odor removal, we always precondition and pre-treat those pet stains present in your fabrics. Once everything is done, we perform a final evaluation of your cleaning process.

#8 Buy Commercial Odor Neutralizers in Stores

When you are unsure of making your homemade odor removal solution, it’s wise to simply buy commercial ones in stores. Also, never forget to read the product label so you can check its compatibility with the kind of fabric on your pet beddings, carpets, and upholstery.

Even when using deodorizing compounds, the bad smell coming from pet accidents won’t go away, unless you have properly sanitized and disinfected it. Your odor neutralizing products are just the finale of your cleaning process.

#9 Inspect and Clean Your Stairs and Closets

Besides your pet’s beddings, they will always have a frequent spot to pee or poop inside your house. With that, you need to locate those areas and clean it properly, so that your fur buddy won’t hit that spot again.
